task: Make the single-prompt Granite binary scoring benchmark repeatable and verify its findings before converting them to points.
nonGoals: No production scoring, rubric, Worker, queue, front end, provider configuration, or usage policy changes. No live inference in CI. No retained merchant data, secrets or live transcripts in Git.

outcomes.description: One prompt asks one binary question per subcheck. Local validation rejects missing, duplicate or unknown IDs, nonbinary answers and reasons exceeding 300 characters.
Only eligible source-matched evidence supports points. Unproved absence stays unmeasured, including findings with model fail answers.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen evidence, expected findings, partial totals and invalid citation cases.

outcomes.description: The benchmark sends one bounded request through the existing guarded Granite provider, measures transport and total elapsed time, and returns provider usage or unknown.
outcomes.evidence: Offline provider, admission denial and 60-second deadline tests.

process.description: Commit the plan before implementation, keep live usage opt-in and guarded, and obtain independent review before opening the change for merge.
process.evidence: Git history, source-bound evaluation and review.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the current Granite, usage and evidence modules and keep the benchmark outside the application path.

exitTest.reason: The local benchmark performs one stateless prompt and has no agent state transfer, resumption or checkpoint protocol.
